scope: Ten existing surface islands, Sobu/Yokosuka B5 two islands, Marunouchi M17 one island; no Keiyo addition
accuracy: Dated multi-epoch visual interpretation, not a measured reconstruction. Google panorama coverage is not independently available for every platform. Tokaido islands use original-author photographs; no fabricated claim of direct Street View coverage. Equipment quantity, placement, dimensions and roof heights are estimated within the inherited model. OCS positions remain model-derived, not surveyed.

street_views_and_primary_sources.observations: Direct 5/6 view and across-track view of 7/8: exposed cream rafters, cable ladders, twin fluorescent rows; shallow pitched canopy and glazed room opposite.
Haunched I-beams, thin steel posts and larger clad supports, dense wiring; curved Chuo acoustic panels opposite.

Direct island 1/2 view: round cream pillars, numbered warning bands, yellow emergency boxes, framed route maps, cream ceiling and coloured square tile inlays. Island 3/4 uses the observed station family and inherited layout; no independent direct panorama claim.
White slatted low ceiling; granite-clad pillars; white half-height gates with red vertical ends; posters and call equipment.
Dark polished column inserts, stainless corners, red-white warning bands, rectangular soffit light fittings, glass lift enclosure and queue markings.
View from 20/21 toward 22/23: curved stainless and dark stone columns nearby; broad white panelled underside and open steel ridge opposite.

street_views_and_primary_sources.provider: User supplied Google Street View screenshots
street_views_and_primary_sources.observations: Retain V20 arched end passage, curved screen-to-canopy ribs, staff room, surveillance and ribbed soffit; silver lower column casing added.
9/10 roof-integrated light-transmitting photovoltaic installation; earlier local PV at 22/23.
Construction contractor account of the roof photovoltaic installation and wiring.
